dict.string: Rings the alarms and timers you set in the Clock, through silent mode and Focus, on your Lock Screen.
Only if you connect Apple Music inside Music: shows your Apple Music library and plays songs through Apple's player.
Takes a photo or short video to send in Messages, and lets a site you're on use your camera when you agree. Totality keeps nothing you don't send.
Totality copies the contacts you choose and encrypts them on this iPhone.

Shows the weather and trails where you are, records your hikes, lets a site you're on see your location when you agree, and lets this iPhone watch for the places in your task reminders. Totality's server never learns where you are, and recorded hikes stay on this iPhone. A location rounded to about 1 km goes to the weather service, and to OpenStreetMap to find trails.
Place reminders in Tasks: this iPhone watches for the places you pick, even while Totality is closed, and rings the reminder when you arrive or leave. Where you are never leaves the iPhone.
Records sound for a short video you send in Messages or a voice clip you post in Social, and lets a site you're on use your microphone when you agree. Totality keeps nothing you don't send.
Only if you turn on Sync this iPhone in Photos: brings your photos into Totality, sealed on this iPhone before they upload. Sync never changes or deletes anything in your library.
Saves a photo or an image from a page to your photos, only when you choose to.
Shows the calendars on this device next to your Totality events. Totality doesn't copy or upload them.
